title: Thesis prep: self-navigated, motion-corrected cardiac MRA (SHARED)

topic.name: Cardiac MRA and motion correction
topic.keywords: "coronary MRA", "whole-heart" MRA, "self-navigation" MRI, "respiratory motion" cardiac MRI, "free-breathing" coronary, "motion-corrected" reconstruction MRI
topic.goal: An MSc thesis that builds on SHARED (Subdivided High-resolution Angiography with Reconstruction of Exchanged Data, Lichthardt et al., ISMRM 2025). SHARED splits a high-resolution whole-heart MRA into self-contained k-space blocks (concentric rings, one breath-hold each) that are reconstructed jointly. The thesis combines SHARED with respiratory self-navigation and retrospective motion correction, so that different respiratory positions between blocks no longer cause artifacts and free-breathing or mixed breathing protocols become possible. Work packages: the k-space sampling pattern for SHARED and self-navigation; extracting a respiratory motion surrogate from the self-navigation data; a motion-corrected joint reconstruction of blocks acquired at different respiratory positions; evaluation in healthy volunteers under breath-held, free-breathing and mixed breathing.

lessons.title: Where the MR signal comes from
lessons.outline: Magnetization, precession, RF excitation and T1/T2 relaxation, and how they create image contrast.

lessons.title: Spatial encoding with gradients
lessons.outline: Slice selection, frequency and phase encoding, and the MR signal equation as a Fourier integral.

lessons.title: k-space
lessons.outline: The Fourier relation between k-space and the image; the centre gives contrast, the edges give detail; resolution and field of view.

lessons.title: 3D Cartesian acquisition
lessons.outline: One readout and two phase-encoding directions, the ky-kz plane, and why scan time grows with resolution.

lessons.title: Non-Cartesian trajectories
lessons.outline: Radial, spiral and 3D radial phyllotaxis sampling, gridding/NUFFT, and why radial readouts tolerate motion and allow self-navigation.

lessons.title: Undersampling and aliasing
lessons.outline: Nyquist sampling, coherent versus incoherent aliasing, and what an acceleration factor means.

lessons.title: Parallel imaging: SENSE
lessons.outline: Coil sensitivities, unfolding aliased pixels, the g-factor and its noise penalty.

lessons.title: Parallel imaging: GRAPPA and ESPIRiT
lessons.outline: Autocalibration, k-space interpolation kernels, and estimating coil sensitivities from calibration data.

lessons.title: Compressed sensing
lessons.outline: Sparsity, incoherent sampling and l1-regularised iterative reconstruction (wavelets, total variation).

lessons.title: Reconstruction as an inverse problem
lessons.outline: The encoding operator (sampling, Fourier transform, coil sensitivities), least squares, conjugate gradient and regularisation.

lessons.title: Cardiac anatomy for whole-heart MRA
lessons.outline: Chambers, great vessels and coronary arteries, their sizes, and what resolution whole-heart MRA needs to show them.

lessons.title: ECG triggering and cardiac motion
lessons.outline: The diastolic rest period, trigger delay, acquisition window and segmented acquisition over many heartbeats.

lessons.title: Contrast in coronary and whole-heart MRA
lessons.outline: Bright-blood bSSFP versus spoiled gradient echo, T2 preparation, fat suppression, and contrast-enhanced versus non-contrast MRA.

lessons.title: Respiratory motion of the heart
lessons.outline: How breathing moves the heart (mainly superior-inferior, a fraction of the diaphragm motion), nonrigid parts, and the resulting blurring and ghosting.

lessons.title: Breath-holding
lessons.outline: Breath-hold duration limits and why the heart's position differs from one breath-hold to the next, which matters for multi-breath-hold methods like SHARED.

lessons.title: Diaphragmatic navigators and prospective gating
lessons.outline: The pencil-beam navigator at the liver-lung interface, acceptance window, tracking factor, scan efficiency and saturation artifacts.

lessons.title: Respiratory self-navigation
lessons.outline: Getting a breathing signal from the imaging data itself: superior-inferior projections from k-space centre lines or radial spokes, and 2D image navigators.

lessons.title: Respiratory surrogates and binning
lessons.outline: Extracting a clean respiratory signal (filtering, PCA, coil selection) and sorting data into respiratory bins or weighting it.

lessons.title: Translational motion correction
lessons.outline: Correcting rigid shifts as k-space phase ramps, 100% scan efficiency, and bin-to-bin image registration.

lessons.title: Generalized and nonrigid motion correction
lessons.outline: Putting motion into the encoding operator (Batchelor's general matrix description) and nonrigid motion-compensated reconstruction with motion fields.

lessons.title: Motion-resolved reconstruction
lessons.outline: Reconstructing extra respiratory or cardiac dimensions (XD-GRASP), sparsity along the motion dimension, and how it compares with motion correction.

lessons.title: Sampling orders for self-navigation
lessons.outline: Golden-angle and golden-step orders, variable-density Cartesian trajectories, and the trade-offs in designing a sampling pattern.

lessons.title: SHARED
lessons.outline: Splitting k-space into concentric rings acquired in separate breath-holds, joint reconstruction of the rings, resolution that grows with every breath-hold, and its open problem: different respiratory positions between blocks.

lessons.title: Combining SHARED with self-navigation
lessons.outline: Estimating each block's respiratory position, registering blocks, and a joint motion-corrected reconstruction for free-breathing or mixed breathing.

lessons.title: Evaluating whole-heart MRA
lessons.outline: Vessel sharpness and visible vessel length (Soap-Bubble), SNR and CNR, reader scores, and designing a small volunteer study.

lessons.title: Tools for reconstruction research
lessons.outline: Working with raw data and open frameworks such as BART, SigPy and Gadgetron for prototyping reconstructions.
